checks.statement: Choose among multi-browse, uncontained, hero, and full-screen layouts; items may be start- or center-aligned and adapt while scrolling.
checks.condition: When selecting a carousel layout; the newer uncontained multi-aspect-ratio variant is also available.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Carousel guidance.

evidence.result: Renderer has layout algorithms for uncontained, full-screen, hero and multi-browse variants; centered alignment is controlled by the selected case/configuration.

implementation.notes: Renderer has layout algorithms for uncontained, full-screen, hero and multi-browse variants; centered alignment is controlled by the selected case/configuration.

checks.statement: Use default free scrolling for uncontained layouts; use snap-scrolling for multi-browse, hero, and full-screen layouts.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: Viewport uses native free scrolling for uncontained layout and mandatory horizontal snap; renderer selects uncontained behavior for that variant.

implementation.notes: Viewport uses native free scrolling for uncontained layout and mandatory horizontal snap; renderer selects uncontained behavior for that variant.

checks.statement: Keep items fully visible except in uncontained layouts and large enough for their imagery/text to remain recognizable.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: Algorithm sizes and clips item windows and keeps the artwork at full visual size, but recognizability of imagery/text is a content decision and needs visual review.

implementation.notes: Algorithm sizes and clips item windows and keeps the artwork at full visual size, but recognizability of imagery/text is a content decision and needs visual review.

checks.statement: On vertically scrolling pages, provide a way to access every item without horizontal scrolling; a Show all destination is recommended, except for full-screen carousels.
checks.condition: For carousels on vertically scrolling pages.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Accessibility requirements on scrolling pages guidance.

evidence.result: Preview provides previous/next item controls only; no Show all destination or vertical-page alternative is rendered.

implementation.notes: Preview provides previous/next item controls only; no Show all destination or vertical-page alternative is rendered.

checks.statement: Use multi-browse for many simple visual items; avoid it for complex imagery or text-heavy items, and at compact breakpoints show at most three text-bearing items.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Multi-browse guidance.

evidence.result: The specimen uses six simple decorative landscape images and no text-bearing content, so content complexity/compact text-item limits do not apply.

implementation.notes: The specimen uses six simple decorative landscape images and no text-bearing content, so content complexity/compact text-item limits do not apply.

checks.statement: Use the uncontained multi-aspect-ratio layout only when items have different widths.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Uncontained multi-aspect ratio guidance.

evidence.result: Renderer supports uncontained sizing, but all six sample items use the same preferred dimensions; no multi-aspect data/configuration is shown.

implementation.notes: Renderer supports uncontained sizing, but all six sample items use the same preferred dimensions; no multi-aspect data/configuration is shown.

checks.statement: Use snap-scrolling for hero layouts so people move through one primary item at a time.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Hero guidance.

evidence.result: All contained layouts use mandatory snap scrolling, including hero; uncontained explicitly uses free scrolling.

implementation.notes: All contained layouts use mandatory snap scrolling, including hero; uncontained explicitly uses free scrolling.

checks.statement: Use full-screen carousels for immersive, visually rich content; use portrait orientation only at compact and medium breakpoints and always snap to the container edges.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Full-screen guidance.

evidence.result: Full-screen algorithm fills its viewport width, but the specimen has a 40rem max-width and no breakpoint/orientation gate for portrait-only compact/medium use.

implementation.notes: Full-screen algorithm fills its viewport width, but the specimen has a 40rem max-width and no breakpoint/orientation gate for portrait-only compact/medium use.

checks.statement: Place initial focus on the first item, allow Tab or arrow keys to move through items, and let up/down arrows leave the carousel for following page content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus guidance.

evidence.result: Focusable viewport precedes item buttons and previous/next controls follow; arrow keys move items and Home/End move endpoints, but no up/down exit behavior is implemented.

implementation.notes: Focusable viewport precedes item buttons and previous/next controls follow; arrow keys move items and Home/End move endpoints, but no up/down exit behavior is implemented.

checks.statement: When reduced motion is enabled, remove parallax and item expansion, keep items the same size, and prevent edge clipping.
checks.condition: When the user requests reduced motion.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Reduced motion guidance.

evidence.result: Reduced-motion branch removes animated settling, but layout still changes item widths and no parallax or edge clipping setting is explicitly disabled by preference.

implementation.notes: Reduced-motion branch removes animated settling, but layout still changes item widths and no parallax or edge clipping setting is explicitly disabled by preference.

checks.statement: Expose the carousel as a labeled container and announce the current item and total item count.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

evidence.result: Carousel section has label and roledescription, and live output announces “Item n of 6” after settling.

implementation.notes: Carousel section has label and roledescription, and live output announces “Item n of 6” after settling.

checks.statement: The uncontained multi-aspect-ratio carousel was added in November 2025; uncontained, full-screen, centered, hero, and multi-browse layouts were added in 2023.
checks.condition: When identifying available Material carousel layouts.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Updates instructions.

evidence.result: Uncontained variant is generated and renderer has a dedicated uncontained layout branch; upstream introduction dates do not constrain runtime behavior.

implementation.notes: Uncontained variant is generated and renderer has a dedicated uncontained layout branch; upstream introduction dates do not constrain runtime behavior.

checks.statement: Let all item widths adapt to the container; large items may have a custom maximum width and small items must stay between 40dp and 56dp.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Carousel item dynamic widths instructions.

evidence.result: Widths adapt to the viewport for multi-browse/hero/full-screen layouts and small is 56px; no 40–56dp small-size bound or maximum large-item rule is enforced.

implementation.notes: Widths adapt to the viewport for multi-browse/hero/full-screen layouts and small is 56px; no 40–56dp small-size bound or maximum large-item rule is enforced.

checks.statement: Show at least one large, medium, and small item in a multi-browse carousel.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Multi-browse instructions.

evidence.result: Multi-browse keyline plan includes small edge items, large items, and an interpolated medium item when the layout fits.

implementation.notes: Multi-browse keyline plan includes small edge items, large items, and an interpolated medium item when the layout fits.

checks.statement: Provide padding on both sides of a multi-browse carousel container.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Viewport has symmetric inline padding and scroll-padding for the contained layout.

implementation.notes: Viewport has symmetric inline padding and scroll-padding for the contained layout.

checks.statement: Allow uncontained items to bleed across the container padding as they scroll.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Viewport negative margins create edge bleed and uncontained free scrolling, but no variant-specific uncontained padding/bleed choice is explicit.

implementation.notes: Viewport negative margins create edge bleed and uncontained free scrolling, but no variant-specific uncontained padding/bleed choice is explicit.

checks.statement: Use leading padding only and 8dp between items in an uncontained multi-aspect-ratio carousel.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Track has a gap and inline-end padding; no dedicated uncontained multi-aspect variant rule establishes leading-only padding or resolved 8dp gap.

implementation.notes: Track has a gap and inline-end padding; no dedicated uncontained multi-aspect variant rule establishes leading-only padding or resolved 8dp gap.

checks.statement: Provide padding on both sides of the hero carousel container.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Hero uses the same viewport with symmetric inline padding and computes side small-item keylines.

implementation.notes: Hero uses the same viewport with symmetric inline padding and computes side small-item keylines.

checks.statement: Provide padding on both sides of a center-aligned hero carousel.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Hero keylines center the main item and the viewport supplies inline padding at both edges.

implementation.notes: Hero keylines center the main item and the viewport supplies inline padding at both edges.

checks.statement: Fill the window edge-to-edge in the full-screen layout.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Carousel root is fixed at 40rem with max-inline-size:100%; no full-window breakout/edge-to-edge rule exists.

implementation.notes: Carousel root is fixed at 40rem with max-inline-size:100%; no full-window breakout/edge-to-edge rule exists.

checks.statement: Place a previewed small item at the leading edge so the large hero item is centered, with a second small preview also visible.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Center-aligned hero instructions.

evidence.result: Hero keylines place small preview items at both edges with the large focal item centered.

implementation.notes: Hero keylines place small preview items at both edges with the large focal item centered.

checks.statement: Let the visible item count vary with layout and breakpoint; the container is rectangular and can stretch to available space.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Container width adapts to its parent and item count/layout changes visible keylines, but rectangular shape and breakpoint-specific count are not asserted in code.

implementation.notes: Container width adapts to its parent and item count/layout changes visible keylines, but rectangular shape and breakpoint-specific count are not asserted in code.

checks.statement: Use large, medium, or small dynamic item widths; keep large items recognizable and consider a narrower large-item maximum only for simple imagery at compact breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Carousel items instructions.

evidence.result: Renderer supports three preset preferred widths and dynamic large/medium/small keylines, but no 40–56dp small range or compact-only large maximum is enforced.

implementation.notes: Renderer supports three preset preferred widths and dynamic large/medium/small keylines, but no 40–56dp small range or compact-only large maximum is enforced.

checks.statement: Keep optional carousel text brief; at compact breakpoints avoid more than two lines unless the background is simple, and adapt text so it remains understandable at each item size.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Item text (optional) instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen items contain decorative SVG art and an aria-hidden number, with no visible text label to wrap or truncate.

implementation.notes: The specimen items contain decorative SVG art and an aria-hidden number, with no visible text label to wrap or truncate.

checks.statement: For text-heavy items, use the uncontained layout or a series of cards instead of a visual-first carousel.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Item text (optional) instructions.

evidence.result: Only decorative imagery is shown, so a text-heavy content layout is not represented.

implementation.notes: Only decorative imagery is shown, so a text-heavy content layout is not represented.

checks.statement: At compact breakpoints, show up to three items at once; larger breakpoints can show and scale more items, while full-screen always shows one.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Adaptive design instructions.

evidence.result: Multi-browse computes keylines from width, but no compact breakpoint caps visible count at three or forces full-screen to one.

implementation.notes: Multi-browse computes keylines from width, but no compact breakpoint caps visible count at three or forces full-screen to one.

checks.statement: Carousel items move with a parallax effect while scrolling.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: Item positions and artwork transforms are updated with shared scroll position; there is no per-item parallax offset or media-motion effect.

implementation.notes: Item positions and artwork transforms are updated with shared scroll position; there is no per-item parallax offset or media-motion effect.

checks.statement: For carousels without headers, provide a Show all button with 4dp padding; for carousels with headers, a 48dp arrow may sit next to the leading-aligned header and open a page that also shows the header.
checks.condition: For carousels on vertically scrolling pages, except full-screen carousels.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Requirements on scrolling pages instructions.

evidence.result: The demo has 48px previous/next icon buttons but no Show all button, header, or all-items destination.

implementation.notes: The demo has 48px previous/next icon buttons but no Show all button, header, or all-items destination.

checks.statement: Prefer the standard Show all solution; if an alternative is required, place it in nearby navigation or near the carousel, keep controls outside the carousel and place them above or below it.
checks.condition: When a product needs an alternative to the recommended all-items control.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Requirements on scrolling pages instructions.

evidence.result: Previous/next controls are placed outside the viewport, below the carousel items.

implementation.notes: Previous/next controls are placed outside the viewport, below the carousel items.

checks.statement: Allow assistive technology users to navigate to the carousel, move between items, activate an item, and skip past the items.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Named carousel, live item count and native item buttons permit navigation/activation; no explicit skip-past control or focus exit with vertical arrows is implemented.

implementation.notes: Named carousel, live item count and native item buttons permit navigation/activation; no explicit skip-past control or focus exit with vertical arrows is implemented.

checks.statement: Tapping a carousel item slightly changes its shape and displays a touch ripple.
checks.condition: When a carousel item is tapped.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Touch instructions.

evidence.result: Shared feedback runtime treats carousel items as button controls and inserts pointer-origin ripple; CSS layers ripple and token state feedback over item artwork.

implementation.notes: Shared feedback runtime treats carousel items as button controls and inserts pointer-origin ripple; CSS layers ripple and token state feedback over item artwork.

checks.statement: Show hover feedback and a click ripple for carousel items.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Cursor instructions.

evidence.result: Item has state layer/ripple and focus styling; this stylesheet contains no explicit hover selector, so generated hover token mapping needs computed browser confirmation.

implementation.notes: Item has state layer/ripple and focus styling; this stylesheet contains no explicit hover selector, so generated hover token mapping needs computed browser confirmation.

checks.statement: Because uncontained carousel items keep one size, additional text or UI may be placed above or below the items without being masked or cropped.
checks.notes: The source ties the layout’s fixed item size to showing additional surrounding content without masking or cropping it.

sourceHistory.summary: The source ties the layout’s fixed item size to showing additional surrounding content without masking or cropping it.

evidence.result: Artwork occupies the item mask and item number overlays within it; surrounding controls are outside the viewport and remain unmasked.

implementation.notes: Artwork occupies the item mask and item number overlays within it; surrounding controls are outside the viewport and remain unmasked.

checks.statement: Tab or the arrow keys move focus to the previous or next carousel item.
checks.condition: When navigating carousel items by keyboard.
checks.notes: Preserves the carousel item focus movement stated in the keyboard table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the carousel item focus movement stated in the keyboard table.

evidence.result: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move to adjacent enabled item; Home/End move to first/last, focusing the target after scroll settles.

implementation.notes: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move to adjacent enabled item; Home/End move to first/last, focusing the target after scroll settles.

checks.statement: Space or Enter activates the focused carousel item.
checks.condition: When a carousel item has keyboard focus.
checks.notes: Preserves the activation keys and outcome from the keyboard table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the activation keys and outcome from the keyboard table.

evidence.result: Each carousel item is a native button, so focused-item activation uses browser Space/Enter button semantics.

implementation.notes: Each carousel item is a native button, so focused-item activation uses browser Space/Enter button semantics.
